scenarios.name: no_override
scenarios.description: Reference vector: no override anywhere in the 48 h window

scenarios.name: override_two_hours
scenarios.description: Reference vector: a 2 h override — normal troubleshooting, well inside max_override_duration

scenarios.name: override_forty_eight_hours
scenarios.description: Reference vector: override held continuously; alarms at max_override_duration (86400 s) + alarm_delay (3600 s) = 90000 s

scenarios.name: release_just_before_alarm
scenarios.description: Timing edge: override released at 88800 s — past max_override_duration but 1200 s short of the alarm; never asserts

scenarios.name: release_resets_duration
scenarios.description: Transient: a 20 h override released at 72000 s; the elapsed duration is discarded, so the remaining 28 h of the window stay clear

scenarios.name: reoverride_restarts_duration
scenarios.description: Transient: released at 72000 s then re-applied at 75600 s; the clock restarts from the re-apply, alarming at 165600 s rather than 90000 s
